subject: Decision Making
subcategory: The Science of Risk and Reward
title: The Risk-Reward Tradeoff
description: A 60-second lesson on The Risk-Reward Tradeoff.

hook.text: Higher returns require higher risk. Stocks beat bonds over decades, but they crash harder in bad years. No free gains.

buildup.text: Since 1926, US stocks returned about 10% annually versus 5% for bonds. But stocks lost over 40% in the worst years.

discovery.text: The equity risk premium is the extra return investors demand for bearing stock market volatility.

twist.text: Crypto promised extreme returns and delivered extreme volatility. Bitcoin dropped 80% multiple times.

climax.text: Anyone promising high returns with low risk is lying or confused. The tradeoff is a law of finance, not a guideline.

punchline.text: Want higher returns? Accept higher risk. There is no shortcut. None.

quiz.question: What is the equity risk premium?
options: The extra return investors demand for bearing stock market volatility over safer bonds
